name: commenter-talent-scan
description: Turn the commenters on a public social media hiring post into a ranked, outreach-ready talent list. Pulls every comment, resolves and enriches each commenter's profile, downloads their profile image, and scores every person with an eval-gated Jev text+images sieve (role depth, hire target vs peer vs brand, role level, primary specialty). Use when asked to: "scan the commenters", "find hires in the comments", "who in these comments is worth hiring", "talent scan this post", "rank the applicants i
author: ericosiu
